_comment: Brutal Cathar day/night: cast T3 at 'neither' -> it becomes DAY, the front face's ETB exiles the opponent's 2/2 (a token -> ceases to exist). End of T3 we cast 1 spell (day stays at the opponent's untap) and the passive opponent casts 0 -> NIGHT before our T4 untap, so it attacks as Moonrage Brute (3/3) on T4 and T5: 20-3-3 = 14. A 2/2 front face would leave 16.
